name: Can AI home search tools help me find off-market properties?

mainEntity.name: Can AI home search tools help me find off-market properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard AI home search tools primarily pull data from publicly available listings, such as Multiple Listing Services (MLS). Therefore, they are generally not designed to discover off-market properties directly. However, they can help identify trends in specific neighborhoods like Pinecrest or Coral Gables that might indicate potential for future off-market opportunities. To access exclusive or pre-market listings, working with an experienced local agent who has a strong network is often more effective, as they often hear about properties before they hit the open market.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI tools typically focus on public listings, not off-market properties. A local real estate agent can better assist with finding exclusive or pre-market listings through their network.
